all-knowing-greaves.name: All-knowing Greaves
all-knowing-greaves.description: Greaves set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear. At the end that should not be.

all-knowing-armor.name: All-knowing Armor
all-knowing-armor.description: Armor set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear. At the end that should not be.

all-knowing-helm.name: All-knowing Helm
all-knowing-helm.description: Helm set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear. At the end that should not be.

alberichs-robe-altered.name: Alberich's Robe (altered)
alberichs-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Mad Tongue Alberich's robe.

all-knowing-armor-altered.name: All-knowing Armor (altered)
all-knowing-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the All-knowing Armor.

aristocrat-coat.name: Aristocrat Coat
aristocrat-coat.description: Tanned leather coat adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

aristocrat-garb.name: Aristocrat Garb
aristocrat-garb.description: High quality garb adorned with fine golden embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Terribly faded and tattered. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

aristocrat-garb-altered.name: Aristocrat Garb (altered)
aristocrat-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Aristocrat Garb.

all-knowing-gauntlets.name: All-knowing Gauntlets
all-knowing-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets set with countless eyes and ears. Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear. At the end that should not be.

azurs-glintstone-robe.name: Azur's Glintstone Robe
azurs-glintstone-robe.description: A robe reserved for grant masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Corroded by blue-green glintstones.

battlemage-robe.name: Battlemage Robe
battlemage-robe.description: Robe worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy scholar, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.

banished-knight-armor-altered.name: Banished Knight Armor (altered)
banished-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Banished Knight Armor.

astrologer-robe.name: Astrologer Robe
astrologer-robe.description: Robe fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

astrologer-robe-altered.name: Astrologer Robe (altered)
astrologer-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Astrologer Robe

beast-champion-armor.name: Beast Champion Armor
beast-champion-armor.description: Silver armor engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant. Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was. Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

black-knife-armor.name: Black Knife Armor
black-knife-armor.description: Scale armor used by the Black Knife Assassins, forged to make no sound. Traces of power yet remain in its concealing veil, which muffles the sound of footsteps. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

beast-champion-armor-altered.name: Beast Champion Armor (altered)
beast-champion-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the  Best Champion Armor

banished-knight-armor.name: Banished Knight Armor
banished-knight-armor.description: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This armor was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

black-knife-armor-altered.name: Black Knife Armor (altered)
black-knife-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Black Knife Armor

bloodsoaked-tabard.name: Bloodsoaked Tabard
bloodsoaked-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with indelible bloodstains around the neck. Worn by headless foot soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

bloodhound-knight-armor-altered.name: Bloodhound Knight Armor (altered)
bloodhound-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Bloodhound Knight Armor

blaidds-armor-altered.name: Blaidd's Armor (altered)
blaidds-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Blaidd's Armor

bloodhound-knight-armor.name: Bloodhound Knight Armor
bloodhound-knight-armor.description: Metal armor with a jutting breastplate.  Worn by the Bloodhound Knights.

blackflame-monk-armor.name: Blackflame Monk Armor
blackflame-monk-armor.description: Black iron armor adorned with ashen cloth.

blaidds-armor.name: Blaidd's Armor
blaidds-armor.description: Well-worn black armor of the man-wolf Blaidd

blue-silver-mail-armor-altered.name: Blue Silver Mail Armor (altered)
blue-silver-mail-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Blue Silver Mail Armor

blue-festive-garb.name: Blue Festive Garb
blue-festive-garb.description: Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Use of this garb, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

blue-cloth-vest.name: Blue Cloth Vest
blue-cloth-vest.description: Vest of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer. Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever drifting.

blue-silver-mail-armor.name: Blue Silver Mail Armor
blue-silver-mail-armor.description: Chainmail armor crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers. Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

braves-battlewear.name: Brave's Battlewear
braves-battlewear.description: Battlewear fashioned from leather armor adorned with a large sheet of cloth. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands The red cloth signifies participation in the Long March long, long ago and this ceremonial garb beseeches the favor of the Warrior King who led them.

briar-armor-altered.name: Briar Armor (altered)
briar-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Briar Armor

carian-knight-armor.name: Carian Knight Armor
carian-knight-armor.description: Armor of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

briar-armor.name: Briar Armor
briar-armor.description: Battered iron armor from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

carian-knight-armor-altered.name: Carian Knight Armor (altered)
carian-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Carian Knight Armor

braves-battlewear-altered.name: Brave's Battlewear (altered)
braves-battlewear-altered.description: Lighter version of the Brave's Battlewear

chain-armor.name: Chain Armor
chain-armor.description: Armor made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

champion-pauldron.name: Champion Pauldron
champion-pauldron.description: Pauldron reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

bull-goat-armor.name: Bull-goat Armor
bull-goat-armor.description: Great Horned Tragoth's armor. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

chain-draped-tabard.name: Chain-draped Tabard
chain-draped-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with a chainmail shawl draped over the shoulders. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

cloth-garb.name: Cloth Garb
cloth-garb.description: Clothing made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

cleanrot-armor-altered.name: Cleanrot Armor (altered)
cleanrot-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Cleanrot Armor

commoners-garb-altered.name: Commoner's Garb (altered)
commoners-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Commoner's Garb

cleanrot-armor.name: Cleanrot Armor
cleanrot-armor.description: Armor of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering. The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles fiercest of all.

commoners-garb.name: Commoner's Garb
commoners-garb.description: Garb with a thick embroidered cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

confessor-armor-altered.name: Confessor Armor (altered)
confessor-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Confessor Armor

confessor-armor.name: Confessor Armor
confessor-armor.description: Black leather armor for blending in with the darkness. Worn by church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

commoners-simple-garb.name: Commoner's Simple Garb
commoners-simple-garb.description: Garb with a modest cloth cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

commoners-simple-garb-altered.name: Commoner's Simple Garb (altered)
commoners-simple-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Commoner's Simple Garb

consorts-robe.name: Consort's Robe
consorts-robe.description: Fine robe of white silk worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor.

crucible-axe-armor.name: Crucible Axe Armor
crucible-axe-armor.description: Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Worn by the knight Ordovis and his men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

corhyns-robe.name: Corhyn's Robe
corhyns-robe.description: Robe of Corhyn the cleric. Even after exile, Corhyn refused to recant his prophecies. And for this, he was blessed with the guidance of grace. Since then, the cart wheel draped on his neck has served as a reminder. That true guidance awaits those with iron wills. Those with unwavering faith.

crucible-tree-armor.name: Crucible Tree Armor
crucible-tree-armor.description: Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Worn by the knight Siluria and her men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

crucible-axe-armor-altered.name: Crucible Axe Armor (altered)
crucible-axe-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Crucible Axe Armor

crucible-tree-armor-altered.name: Crucible Tree Armor (altered)
crucible-tree-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Crucible Tree Armor

cuckoo-surcoat.name: Cuckoo Surcoat
cuckoo-surcoat.description: Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. The surcoat depicts twinned cuckoos peering into a flourishing mass of glintstone. To a glintstone sorcerer, the body is a transient thing. The Cuckoo alone knows its insignificance, yet watches over it all the same.

cuckoo-knight-armor.name: Cuckoo Knight Armor
cuckoo-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights.

cuckoo-knight-armor-altered.name: Cuckoo Knight Armor (altered)
cuckoo-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Cuckoo Knight Armor

deathbed-dress.name: Deathbed Dress
deathbed-dress.description: Extremely thin and sheer white dress worn by the Deathbed Companion as she embraces the dead. Slowly replenishes the HP of nearby allies, but not that of the wearer. The touch of the fabric is exceedingly soft, so as not to harm even the most withered corpse, while still sharing her warmth.

depraved-perfumer-robe.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe
depraved-perfumer-robe.description: Robe worn by depraved perfumers. The embroidery on the apron is itself a curse upon the Erdtree. These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is  what earned them their name.

drake-knight-armor.name: Drake Knight Armor
drake-knight-armor.description: Black iron armor worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partake of communion. The cape is crafted with dragon wing membrane.

drake-knight-armor-altered.name: Drake Knight Armor (altered)
drake-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Drake Knight Armor

depraved-perfumer-robe-altered.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe (altered)
depraved-perfumer-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Depraved Perfumer Robe

elden-lord-armor-altered.name: Elden Lord Armor (altered)
elden-lord-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Elden Lord Armor

elden-lord-armor.name: Elden Lord Armor
elden-lord-armor.description: Armor of Godfrey the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

dirty-chainmail.name: Dirty Chainmail
dirty-chainmail.description: Chainmail worn by young Albinaurics. The appearance of a protruding belly provides no benefits worthy of note.

errant-sorcerer-robe.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe
errant-sorcerer-robe.description: Commonplace robe made of thick cloth. Worn by the Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, one of the first Tarnished to visit Roundtable Hold. A silent seeker of sorcery, who had gone so far as to make contact with the primeval current, Wilhelm was led by guidance into confrontation with his friend Vargram, and it is said that he was then taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold.

erdtree-surcoat.name: Erdtree Surcoat
erdtree-surcoat.description: Armor worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. The surcoat bears a majestic likeness of the Erdtree. Its golden backing is an honor bestowed on no other soldiers.

eccentrics-armor.name: Eccentric's Armor
eccentrics-armor.description: Unusually colorful armor. Worn by the knight Jerren. Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as guest of the Carian royals, he became a guest commander for General Radahn. And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath

festive-garb.name: Festive Garb
festive-garb.description: Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Faintly bloodstained.

errant-sorcerer-robe-altered.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe (altered)
errant-sorcerer-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Errant Sorcerer Robe.

festive-garb-altered.name: Festive Garb (altered)
festive-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the  Festive Garb.

fias-robe.name: Fia's Robe
fias-robe.description: Robe of black cloth that covers the entire body. Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

fell-omen-cloak.name: Fell Omen Cloak
fell-omen-cloak.description: "A cloak of ragged fur worn about the exposed body of Margit, the Fell Omen.

exile-armor.name: Exile Armor
exile-armor.description: Damaged armor draped with a large deep-red cloth. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

finger-maiden-robe-altered.name: Finger Maiden Robe (altered)
finger-maiden-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Finger Maiden Robe.

finger-maiden-robe.name: Finger Maiden Robe
finger-maiden-robe.description: Robe worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers. The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

fingerprint-armor.name: Fingerprint Armor
fingerprint-armor.description: Iron armor singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

fingerprint-armor-altered.name: Fingerprint Armor (altered)
fingerprint-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Fingerprint Armor.

fur-raiment.name: Fur Raiment
fur-raiment.description: Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower warriors. The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

gelmir-knight-armor.name: Gelmir Knight Armor
gelmir-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights once royal to Praector Rykard.

gelmir-knight-armor-altered.name: Gelmir Knight Armor (altered)
gelmir-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Gelmir Knight Armor.

fire-prelate-armor.name: Fire Prelate Armor
fire-prelate-armor.description: Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

godrick-knight-armor.name: Godrick Knight Armor
godrick-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights loyal to Godrick The Grafted.

godksin-noble-robe.name: Godksin Noble Robe
godksin-noble-robe.description: Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles known for their seven-face aprons. Strengthens the Noble Presence incantation. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

fire-prelate-armor-altered.name: Fire Prelate Armor (altered)
fire-prelate-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Fire Prelate Armor.

foot-soldier-tabard.name: Foot Soldier Tabard
foot-soldier-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with more than a few stains. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

fire-monk-armor.name: Fire Monk Armor
fire-monk-armor.description: Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth. Attire of the Fire Monks.

godrick-knight-armor-altered.name: Godrick Knight Armor (altered)
godrick-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Godric Knight Armor.

goldmasks-rags.name: Goldmask's Rags
goldmasks-rags.description: Worn rags that just barely cover the body. Lord Goldmask felt no draw to the vain excess of clothing; what use is finery to one who seeks greater brilliance?

gravekeeper-cloak.name: Gravekeeper Cloak
gravekeeper-cloak.description: Defensive wear encircled by bronze snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

godskin-apostle-robe.name: Godskin Apostle Robe
godskin-apostle-robe.description: Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.

haligtree-crest-surcoat.name: Haligtree Crest Surcoat
haligtree-crest-surcoat.description: Armor worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. The surcoat bears the crest of the Haligtree. Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.

gravekeeper-cloak-altered.name: Gravekeeper Cloak (altered)
gravekeeper-cloak-altered.description: Lighter version of the Gravekeeper Cloak.

guardian-garb.name: Guardian Garb
guardian-garb.description: Engraved golden garb. Worn by guardians of the Minor Erdtree.

haligtree-knight-armor.name: Haligtree Knight Armor
haligtree-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights sworn the Haligtree.

guardian-garb-full-bloom.name: Guardian Garb (full Bloom)
guardian-garb-full-bloom.description: Engraved golden garb. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees. Raises the HP recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears, but greatly lowers fire damage negation. It is said that the blood-red flowers blooming on their backs mark the senescence of their ancient pact. Perhaps the guardians are part tree already

haligtree-knight-armor-altered.name: Haligtree Knight Armor (altered)
haligtree-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Haligtree Knight Armor.

high-page-clothes.name: High Page Clothes
high-page-clothes.description: Clothes of a page selected for special privileges by the noble they serve.

highwayman-cloth-armor.name: Highwayman Cloth Armor
highwayman-cloth-armor.description: Hideously stained and ragged cloth armor. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

high-page-clothes-altered.name: High Page Clothes (altered)
high-page-clothes-altered.description: Lighter version of the High Page Clothes.

hoslows-armor.name: Hoslow's Armor
hoslows-armor.description: Garish silver armor decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family. When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused. "I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."

ivory-draped-tabard.name: Ivory-draped Tabard
ivory-draped-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with a shawl in the color of ivory draped over the shoulders. Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

knight-armor.name: Knight Armor
knight-armor.description: Iron armor of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

juvenile-scholar-robe.name: Juvenile Scholar Robe
juvenile-scholar-robe.description: Robe worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria Academy. Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it. Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

land-of-reeds-armor.name: Land Of Reeds Armor
land-of-reeds-armor.description: Armor made from strips of iron fastened together. Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds. The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil war, during which time it has remained alienated from the cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.

hoslows-armor-altered.name: Hoslow's Armor (altered)
hoslows-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Hoslow's Armor.

lazuli-robe.name: Lazuli Robe
lazuli-robe.description: Robe worn by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus, singular among the greater Raya Lucaria Academy. These scholars, who sought to master Carian sorcery, instead learned to see the moon as equal to the stars. This robe, in the hue of the full moon, signifies their heresy.

leather-armor.name: Leather Armor
leather-armor.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather armor worn by a savvy soldier.

leather-draped-tabard.name: Leather-draped Tabard
leather-draped-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with a leather shawl draped over the shoulders.

lionels-armor-altered.name: Lionel's Armor (altered)
lionels-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Lionel's Armor.

leyndell-knight-armor-altered.name: Leyndell Knight Armor (altered)
leyndell-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Leyndell Knight Armor.

leyndell-knight-armor.name: Leyndell Knight Armor
leyndell-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Its left breast is emblazoned with a symbol of Erdtree Worship, said to have once been imbued with an incantation of protection.

lionels-armor.name: Lionel's Armor
lionels-armor.description: Round iron armor with a banner extending from its back. Worn by the Lionel the Lionhearted.

lord-of-bloods-robe.name: Lord Of Blood's Robe
lord-of-bloods-robe.description: Attire of Mohg, Lord of Blood, embroidered with an extravagant gold emblem on black cloth. The dress of a Luminary, the reigning lord and hierarch of the coming dynasty of Mohgwyn. Or perhaps, of a raving lunatic.

lusats-robe.name: Lusat's Robe
lusats-robe.description: A robe reserved for grand masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Corroded by blue glintstones.

lord-of-bloods-robe-altered.name: Lord Of Blood's Robe (altered)
lord-of-bloods-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Lord Of Blood's Robe.

malenias-armor.name: Malenia's Armor
malenias-armor.description: Armor made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god - he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

malikeths-armor-altered.name: Maliketh's Armor (altered)
malikeths-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Maliketh's Armor.

malenias-armor-altered.name: Malenia's Armor (altered)
malenias-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Maleinia's Armor.

malformed-dragon-armor.name: Malformed Dragon Armor
malformed-dragon-armor.description: Malformed golden armor. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels. After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

malikeths-armor.name: Maliketh's Armor
malikeths-armor.description: Beast's armor made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.

marionette-soldier-armor.name: Marionette Soldier Armor
marionette-soldier-armor.description: Armor of metal bands arranged in a lattice. Worn by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers. The construction of this armor is remarkably crude, now rusted over and severely dented. For a doll, the only thing that matters is that it does not break.

marais-robe.name: Marais Robe
marais-robe.description: Robe with a black mantle across the shoulders. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais. The sons of House Marais are all sickly born. Little wonder that Maleigh Marais would be so beguiled by the beautiful and fierce goddess who was born into rot.

mausoleum-knight-armor.name: Mausoleum Knight Armor
mausoleum-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. The wing-shaped ornaments on its back evoke the Deathbird. A self-inflicted curse that ties the spirits of these loyal knights to the land, having willingly beheaded themselves so that they may serve theirs masters in death.

mausoleum-surcoat.name: Mausoleum Surcoat
mausoleum-surcoat.description: Armor worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

mausoleum-knight-armor-altered.name: Mausoleum Knight Armor (altered)
mausoleum-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Mausoleum Knight Armor

mushroom-body.name: Mushroom Body
mushroom-body.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the torso. To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

nomadic-merchants-finery-altered.name: Nomadic Merchant's Finery (altered)
nomadic-merchants-finery-altered.description: Lighter version of the Nomadic Merchant's Finery

nights-cavalry-armor-altered.name: Night's Cavalry Armor (altered)
nights-cavalry-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Night's Cavalry Armor

nights-cavalry-armor.name: Night's Cavalry Armor
nights-cavalry-armor.description: Pitch-black armor thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

night-maiden-armor.name: Night Maiden Armor
night-maiden-armor.description: Armor worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and includes a silk cape. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

nobles-traveling-garb.name: Noble's Traveling Garb
nobles-traveling-garb.description: Traveling attire fashioned from metallic white silk thread. Worn by expatriated royalty. A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

nox-monk-armor.name: Nox Monk Armor
nox-monk-armor.description: Armor worn by the monks of the Eternal City, with a silk cape attached. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

nox-swordstress-armor-altered.name: Nox Swordstress Armor (altered)
nox-swordstress-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Nox Swordstress Armor.

nox-monk-armor-altered.name: Nox Monk Armor (altered)
nox-monk-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Nox Monk Armor.

nox-swordstress-armor.name: Nox Swordstress Armor
nox-swordstress-armor.description: Armor worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City. These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens, and wear silk capes. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

omen-armor.name: Omen Armor
omen-armor.description: Malformed armor resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

officials-attire.name: Official's Attire
officials-attire.description: Grubby blue robe worn by magisterial officials to carry out their grim tasks. Surveillance, executions, gruesome rituals... The darkest duties drive the wheels of mankind.

page-garb.name: Page Garb
page-garb.description: Garb worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

perfumers-traveling-garb.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb
perfumers-traveling-garb.description: Garb of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

page-garb-altered.name: Page Garb (altered)
page-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Page Garb.

perfumer-robe.name: Perfumer Robe
perfumer-robe.description: Robe of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

perfumers-traveling-garb-altered.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb (altered)
perfumers-traveling-garb-altered.description: Lighter version of the Perfumer's Traveling Garb.

perfumer-robe-altered.name: Perfumer Robe (altered)
perfumer-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Perfurmer's Robe.

omenkiller-robe.name: Omenkiller Robe
omenkiller-robe.description: Robe worn by the Omenkillers, butchers of twisted conscience.

old-aristocrat-gown.name: Old Aristocrat Gown
old-aristocrat-gown.description: Gown of soft cloth adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

preceptors-long-gown-altered.name: Preceptor's Long Gown (altered)
preceptors-long-gown-altered.description: Lighter version of the Preceptor's Long Gown.

preceptors-long-gown.name: Preceptor's Long Gown
preceptors-long-gown.description: A long, bright blue gown with the movements of the stars drawn upon it. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals. Glintstone sorcerers are the descendants of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.

prophet-robe-altered.name: Prophet Robe (altered)
prophet-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Prophet Robe.

queens-robe.name: Queen's Robe
queens-robe.description: Robe indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

prophet-robe.name: Prophet Robe
prophet-robe.description: Robe of exiled prophets who foresaw that their faith would end in flames — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Its fabric scrapes against their skin like a file, and the rickety cart wheel around the neck warns passers-by not to lend an ear to their meandering sermons.

prisoner-clothing.name: Prisoner Clothing
prisoner-clothing.description: Tattered clothing. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Never once washed, every fiber is filthy.

ragged-armor.name: Ragged Armor
ragged-armor.description: Armor pieced together from scavenged metal.

ragged-armor-altered.name: Ragged Armor (altered)
ragged-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Ragged Armor.

radahns-lion-armor-altered.name: Radahn's Lion Armor (altered)
radahns-lion-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Radahn's Lion Armor.

radahns-lion-armor.name: Radahn's Lion Armor
radahns-lion-armor.description: Armor depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

raging-wolf-armor-altered.name: Raging Wolf Armor (altered)
raging-wolf-armor-altered.description: Armor worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

raya-lucarian-robe.name: Raya Lucarian Robe
raya-lucarian-robe.description: Robe worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Those who dedicate themselves to the study of glintstones formed from starry amber receive this modest yet elegant deep blue garb along with their vows of virtue and austerity. But with extended life, one is apt to forget old vows.

raging-wolf-armor.name: Raging Wolf Armor
raging-wolf-armor.description: Armor worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold. According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean. Vargram aspired to such a state himself.

redmane-surcoat.name: Redmane Surcoat
redmane-surcoat.description: Armor worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side.

ronins-armor.name: Ronin's Armor
ronins-armor.description: Armor of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

rotten-gravekeeper-cloak.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak
rotten-gravekeeper-cloak.description: Thick, bristly cloak eaten through by scarlet rot. The symbol of an underground gravekeeper's station.

redmane-knight-armor-altered.name: Redmane Knight Armor (altered)
redmane-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Redmane Knight Armor. The armor is not as sturdy as the original, but it still provides a decent amount of protection.

ronins-armor-altered.name: Ronin's Armor (altered)
ronins-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Ronin's Armor. The armor is not as sturdy as the original, but it still provides a decent amount of protection.

redmane-knight-armor.name: Redmane Knight Armor
redmane-knight-armor.description: Armor worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

raptors-black-feathers.name: Raptor's Black Feathers
raptors-black-feathers.description: Robe crafted with the black feathers of a bird of prey. Worn by the assassin Ravenmount.

royal-knight-armor.name: Royal Knight Armor
royal-knight-armor.description: Silver armor of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

royal-knight-armor-altered.name: Royal Knight Armor (altered)
royal-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Royal Knight Armor. The armor is not as sturdy as the original, but it still provides a decent amount of protection.

rotten-gravekeeper-cloak-altered.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak (altered)
rotten-gravekeeper-cloak-altered.description: Lighter version of the Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak.

royal-remains-armor.name: Royal Remains Armor
royal-remains-armor.description: Armory graces with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

scaled-armor.name: Scaled Armor
scaled-armor.description: Armor worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks.

sanguine-noble-robe.name: Sanguine Noble Robe
sanguine-noble-robe.description: Robe of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood. The grand metallic pattern on the shoulder is a signifier of the noble rank they intend to claim upon the advent of the new dynasty they are working to install.

rulers-robe.name: Ruler's Robe
rulers-robe.description: Luxurious robe worn by lords in a smaller nation. Its fine blue mantle serves to prove its wearer's status.

scaled-armor-altered.name: Scaled Armor (altered)
scaled-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Scaled Armor

sage-robe.name: Sage Robe
sage-robe.description: Thick burgundy robe. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

scale-armor.name: Scale Armor
scale-armor.description: Armor reinforced with small metal scales. The cape covering the shoulders is made with treated rock lizard skin, and provides ample protection against fire.

traveling-maiden-robe-altered.name: Traveling Maiden Robe (altered)
traveling-maiden-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Traveling Maiden Robe

snow-witch-robe-altered.name: Snow Witch Robe (altered)
snow-witch-robe-altered.description: Lighter version of the Snow Witch Robe

scarlet-tabard.name: Scarlet Tabard
scarlet-tabard.description: Padded cloth armor with the telltale stains of the scarlet rot. Worn by foot soldiers in General Radahn's army

shaman-furs.name: Shaman Furs
shaman-furs.description: Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

traveling-maiden-robe.name: Traveling Maiden Robe
traveling-maiden-robe.description: Robe worn by traveling maidens. Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

snow-witch-robe.name: Snow Witch Robe
snow-witch-robe.description: Witch's robe in the color of snow. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

tree-sentinel-armor.name: Tree Sentinel Armor
tree-sentinel-armor.description: Golden armor of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

spellblades-traveling-attire-altered.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire (altered)
spellblades-traveling-attire-altered.description: Lighter version of the Spellblade's Traveling Attire

spellblades-traveling-attire.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire
spellblades-traveling-attire.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

tree-sentinel-armor-altered.name: Tree Sentinel Armor (altered)
tree-sentinel-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Tree Sentinel Armor

twinned-armor-altered.name: Twinned Armor (altered)
twinned-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Twinned Armor

vagabond-knight-armor-altered.name: Vagabond Knight Armor (altered)
vagabond-knight-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Vagabond Knight Armor

vagabond-knight-armor.name: Vagabond Knight Armor
vagabond-knight-armor.description: Chest piece of a knight banished from their motherland.  Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

veterans-armor.name: Veteran's Armor
veterans-armor.description: Old armor that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol. Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master. This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.

twinned-armor.name: Twinned Armor
twinned-armor.description: Armor depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

veterans-armor-altered.name: Veteran's Armor (altered)
veterans-armor-altered.description: Lighter version of the Veteran's Armor

tree-surcoat.name: Tree Surcoat
tree-surcoat.description: Blue surcoat draped over chainmail. The tree insignia emblazoned on the front depicts the Erdtree, and is a design beloved throughout the Lands Between.

upper-class-robe.name: Upper-class Robe
upper-class-robe.description: Embroidered, bright green robe worn by noble children. Donning such a robe is traditionally the child's first show of burgeoning independence.

tree-and-beast-surcoat.name: Tree-and-beast Surcoat
tree-and-beast-surcoat.description: Armor worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. The surcoat depicts the distant Erdtree and the beast regent, an emblem of the golden lineage. Both are symbols of glory now past.

vulgar-militia-armor.name: Vulgar Militia Armor
vulgar-militia-armor.description: Armor worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

white-reed-armor.name: White Reed Armor
white-reed-armor.description: Armor of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by the Inabam head disciples of the great swordsman Okina.

war-surgeon-gown.name: War Surgeon Gown
war-surgeon-gown.description: "Bloodstained white gown of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception."

war-surgeon-gown-altered.name: War Surgeon Gown (altered)
war-surgeon-gown-altered.description: Lighter version of the War Surgeon Gown.

azurs-manchettes.name: Azur's Manchettes
azurs-manchettes.description: Manchettes corroded by blue-green glintstones. Worn by Azur, primeval current sorcerer.

battlemage-manchettes.name: Battlemage Manchettes
battlemage-manchettes.description: Manchettes worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.

astrologer-gloves.name: Astrologer Gloves
astrologer-gloves.description: Gloves fashioned from fine, supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

bandit-manchettes.name: Bandit Manchettes
bandit-manchettes.description: Manchettes made by simple wrapping dirty cloth around the arms. Worn by bandits.

banished-knight-gauntlets.name: Banished Knight Gauntlets
banished-knight-gauntlets.description: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. These gauntlets were worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

zamor-armor.name: Zamor Armor
zamor-armor.description: Armor worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants. These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.

beast-champion-gauntlets.name: Beast Champion Gauntlets
beast-champion-gauntlets.description: Silver gauntlets engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant. Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was. Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

black-knife-gauntlets.name: Black Knife Gauntlets
black-knife-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets used by the Black Knife Assassins. Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

blackflame-monk-gauntlets.name: Blackflame Monk Gauntlets
blackflame-monk-gauntlets.description: Black iron gauntlets featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

blaidds-gauntlets.name: Blaidd's Gauntlets
blaidds-gauntlets.description: Well-worn black gauntlets of the man-wolf Blaidd.

braves-bracer.name: Brave's Bracer
braves-bracer.description: Gauntlets wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. Has a fur lining which excels at keeping the cold at bay.

briar-gauntlets.name: Briar Gauntlets
briar-gauntlets.description: Battered iron gauntlets from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

bull-goat-gauntlets.name: Bull-goat Gauntlets
bull-goat-gauntlets.description: Great Horned Tragoth's gauntlets. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

bloodsoaked-manchettes.name: Bloodsoaked Manchettes
bloodsoaked-manchettes.description: Manchettes formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood. Any protection is welcome for the festering arms beneath.

bloodhound-knight-gauntlets.name: Bloodhound Knight Gauntlets
bloodhound-knight-gauntlets.description: Metal gauntlets of the Bloodhound Knights.

blue-silver-bracelets.name: Blue Silver Bracelets
blue-silver-bracelets.description: Bracelets crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

carian-knight-gauntlets.name: Carian Knight Gauntlets
carian-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen,  were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

chain-gauntlets.name: Chain Gauntlets
chain-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

cuckoo-knight-gauntlets.name: Cuckoo Knight Gauntlets
cuckoo-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

confessor-gloves.name: Confessor Gloves
confessor-gloves.description: Black leather gloves of the church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

cleanrot-gauntlets.name: Cleanrot Gauntlets
cleanrot-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering. The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles fiercest of all.

champion-bracers.name: Champion Bracers
champion-bracers.description: Bracers reserved for the bandlands' bravest.  Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes.  Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

champion-gauntlets.name: Champion Gauntlets
champion-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

elden-lord-bracers.name: Elden Lord Bracers
elden-lord-bracers.description: Bracers of Godfrey the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

eccentrics-manchettes.name: Eccentric's Manchettes
eccentrics-manchettes.description: The knight Jerren's manchettes. Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became the guest commander for General Radahn. And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

drake-knight-gauntlets.name: Drake Knight Gauntlets
drake-knight-gauntlets.description: Black iron gauntlets worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion. From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe

crucible-gauntlets.name: Crucible Gauntlets
crucible-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Hold the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthen Aspects of the Crucible incantations. In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

errant-sorcerer-manchettes.name: Errant Sorcerer Manchettes
errant-sorcerer-manchettes.description: Commonplace leather manchettes. Their hands are inlaid with dulled glintstone.

fire-monk-gauntlets.name: Fire Monk Gauntlets
fire-monk-gauntlets.description: Black iron gauntlets featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Fire Monks.

godrick-knight-gauntlets.name: Godrick Knight Gauntlets
godrick-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time has yet to dull their luster.

gelmir-knight-gauntlets.name: Gelmir Knight Gauntlets
gelmir-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Time has yet to dull their luster.

foot-soldier-gauntlets.name: Foot Soldier Gauntlets
foot-soldier-gauntlets.description: Metal gauntlets covered in nicks and dents. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

exile-gauntlets.name: Exile Gauntlets
exile-gauntlets.description: Damaged iron gauntlets. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

fingerprint-gauntlets.name: Fingerprint Gauntlets
fingerprint-gauntlets.description: Iron gauntlets singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

godrick-soldier-gauntlets.name: Godrick Soldier Gauntlets
godrick-soldier-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

fire-prelate-gauntlets.name: Fire Prelate Gauntlets
fire-prelate-gauntlets.description: Black iron gauntlets with the appearance of flames. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

godskin-apostle-bracelets.name: Godskin Apostle Bracelets
godskin-apostle-bracelets.description: Black bracelets of the Godskin Apostles.

highwayman-gauntlets.name: Highwayman Gauntlets
highwayman-gauntlets.description: Hideously stained and dented gauntlets. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

godskin-noble-bracelets.name: Godskin Noble Bracelets
godskin-noble-bracelets.description: Black bracelets of the Godskin Nobles. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

haligtree-gauntlets.name: Haligtree Gauntlets
haligtree-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

haligtree-knight-gauntlets.name: Haligtree Knight Gauntlets
haligtree-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.

hoslows-gauntlets.name: Hoslow's Gauntlets
hoslows-gauntlets.description: Garish silver gauntlets decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family.

gold-bracelets.name: Gold Bracelets
gold-bracelets.description: Bracelets made in the image of Erdtree branches. Minimal adornments made my Lord Goldmask's disciples. Those disciples have long since left him.

guardian-bracers.name: Guardian Bracers
guardian-bracers.description: Engraved golden bracers. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtree.

golden-prosthetic.name: Golden Prosthetic
golden-prosthetic.description: Golden prosthetic forged using ancient techniques

knight-gauntlets.name: Knight Gauntlets
knight-gauntlets.description: Iron gauntlets of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

land-of-reeds-gauntlets.name: Land Of Reeds Gauntlets
land-of-reeds-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets wrapped in tough leather. Worn by the warriors of the Land of Reeds

lusats-manchettes.name: Lusat's Manchettes
lusats-manchettes.description: Manchettes corroded by blue glintstones. Worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

malikeths-gauntlets.name: Maliketh's Gauntlets
malikeths-gauntlets.description: Beast's gauntlets made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyral half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions

leyndell-soldier-gauntlets.name: Leyndell Soldier Gauntlets
leyndell-soldier-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

leather-gloves.name: Leather Gloves
leather-gloves.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather gloves worn by a savvy soldier. Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

malenias-gauntlet.name: Malenia's Gauntlet
malenias-gauntlet.description: Gauntlet made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

leyndell-knight-gauntlets.name: Leyndell Knight Gauntlets
leyndell-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster

omen-gauntlets.name: Omen Gauntlets
omen-gauntlets.description: Malformed Gauntlets resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

mushroom-arms.name: Mushroom Arms
mushroom-arms.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the arms.

mausoleum-knight-gauntlets.name: Mausoleum Knight Gauntlets
mausoleum-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Walking Mausoleum. Time has yet to dull their luster.

mausoleum-gauntlets.name: Mausoleum Gauntlets
mausoleum-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

millicents-gloves.name: Millicent's Gloves
millicents-gloves.description: Gloves worn by Millicent the Rotting

nox-monk-bracelets.name: Nox Monk Bracelets
nox-monk-bracelets.description: Bracelets worn by the monks of the Eternal City. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

nobles-gloves.name: Noble's Gloves
nobles-gloves.description: Gloves of plush leather. Worn by expatriated royalty. A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

perfumer-gloves.name: Perfumer Gloves
perfumer-gloves.description: Gloves of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

nights-cavalry-gauntlets.name: Night's Cavalry Gauntlets
nights-cavalry-gauntlets.description: Pitch-black gauntlets thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

omenkiller-long-gloves.name: Omenkiller Long Gloves
omenkiller-long-gloves.description: Long,stiff leather gloves worn by the Omenkillers.

preceptors-gloves.name: Preceptor's Gloves
preceptors-gloves.description: Trousers of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.

raya-lucarian-gauntlets.name: Raya Lucarian Gauntlets
raya-lucarian-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

ragged-gloves.name: Ragged Gloves
ragged-gloves.description: Gauntlets pieced together from scavenged metal.

radahn-soldier-gauntlets.name: Radahn Soldier Gauntlets
radahn-soldier-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

radahns-gauntlets.name: Radahn's Gauntlets
radahns-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

royal-knight-gauntlets.name: Royal Knight Gauntlets
royal-knight-gauntlets.description: Silver gauntlets of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

ronins-gauntlets.name: Ronin's Gauntlets
ronins-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

queens-bracelets.name: Queen's Bracelets
queens-bracelets.description: Bracelets indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

royal-remains-gauntlets.name: Royal Remains Gauntlets
royal-remains-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets graces with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

travelers-gloves.name: Traveler's Gloves
travelers-gloves.description: Gloves of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

tree-sentinel-gauntlets.name: Tree Sentinel Gauntlets
tree-sentinel-gauntlets.description: Golden gauntlets of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

sorcerer-manchettes.name: Sorcerer Manchettes
sorcerer-manchettes.description: Manchettes worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the forearms.

twinned-gauntlets.name: Twinned Gauntlets
twinned-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

vagabond-knight-gauntlets.name: Vagabond Knight Gauntlets
vagabond-knight-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of a knight banished form their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey. Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.

veterans-gauntlets.name: Veteran's Gauntlets
veterans-gauntlets.description: Old gauntlets that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.

scaled-gauntlets.name: Scaled Gauntlets
scaled-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks. Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survived to this day.

spellblades-gloves.name: Spellblade's Gloves
spellblades-gloves.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

vulgar-militia-gauntlets.name: Vulgar Militia Gauntlets
vulgar-militia-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

aristocrat-hat.name: Aristocrat Hat
aristocrat-hat.description: Leather hat decorated with a withered feather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor.

warrior-gauntlets.name: Warrior Gauntlets
warrior-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of a nomadic warrior. Crafted from sturdy leather.

alberichs-pointed-hat-altered.name: Alberich's Pointed Hat (altered)
alberichs-pointed-hat-altered.description: Lighter version of the Alberich's Pointed Hat.

alberichs-pointed-hat.name: Alberich's Pointed Hat
alberichs-pointed-hat.description: Mad Tongue Alberich's pointed hat, a sign of a heretical practitioner.

war-surgeon-gloves.name: War Surgeon Gloves
war-surgeon-gloves.description: Bloodstained white gloves of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception

zamor-bracelets.name: Zamor Bracelets
zamor-bracelets.description: Bracelets worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants. These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.

white-reed-gauntlets.name: White Reed Gauntlets
white-reed-gauntlets.description: Gauntlets of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by the Inabam head disciples of the great swordsman Okina. The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothingmore than to die by the sword.

bandit-mask.name: Bandit Mask
bandit-mask.description: Mask of black cloth that covers the mouth. Favored by bandits for hiding their faces, it also provides some protection against poison.

black-dumpling.name: Black Dumpling
black-dumpling.description: Mask forced on a victim's head to lend torture an extra degree of cruelty. It magnifies one's fears and make them acutely aware of all forms of pain Raises attack power when the wearer suffers from madness. When the Black Dumpling goes on, the torturer no longer seeks answers; only to inflict suffering without hope of relief.

banished-knight-helm-altered.name: Banished Knight Helm (altered)
banished-knight-helm-altered.description: Lighter version of the Banished Knight Helm

ash-of-war-scarab.name: Ash-of-war Scarab
ash-of-war-scarab.description: Gray scarab worn directly on the head.

astrologer-hood.name: Astrologer Hood
astrologer-hood.description: Hood fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

black-hood.name: Black Hood
black-hood.description: Hood of lusterless black fabric that conceals its wearer's identity.

azurs-glintstone-crown.name: Azur's Glintstone Crown
azurs-glintstone-crown.description: Crown of Azur, primeval current sorcerer, set with a prominent blue-green glintstone.

banished-knight-helm.name: Banished Knight Helm
banished-knight-helm.description: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

beast-champion-helm.name: Beast Champion Helm
beast-champion-helm.description: Silver helm engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

black-wolf-mask.name: Black Wolf Mask
black-wolf-mask.description: A mask fashioned after the head of a black wolf.

bloodsoaked-mask.name: Bloodsoaked Mask
bloodsoaked-mask.description: Mask formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood. Even the most ghastly cover is more inviting than the festering face beneath.

black-knife-hood.name: Black Knife Hood
black-knife-hood.description: Hood used by the Black Knife Assassins. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be N u men who had close ties with Marika herself.

blue-silver-mail-hood.name: Blue Silver Mail Hood
blue-silver-mail-hood.description: Chainmail hood crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

bloodhound-knight-helm.name: Bloodhound Knight Helm
bloodhound-knight-helm.description: Metal helm with a pointed beak. Worn by the Bloodhound Knights. The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers. Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

blackguards-iron-mask.name: Blackguard's Iron Mask
blackguards-iron-mask.description: Iron mask forced on convicted prisoners. Worn by the blackguard Big Boggart. To Boggart, the mask made him all the more threatening, and helped him get what he wanted. But it was also a mirror of his emptiness.

blue-festive-hood.name: Blue Festive Hood
blue-festive-hood.description: Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Use of this hood, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

blackflame-monk-hood.name: Blackflame Monk Hood
blackflame-monk-hood.description: Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with black flames.

blue-cloth-cowl.name: Blue Cloth Cowl
blue-cloth-cowl.description: Cowl of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer. Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever-drifting.

champion-headband.name: Champion Headband
champion-headband.description: Headband reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

chain-coif.name: Chain Coif
chain-coif.description: Coif made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

bull-goat-helm.name: Bull-goat Helm
bull-goat-helm.description: Great Horned Tragoth's helm, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provides high poise.

braves-cord-circlet.name: Brave's Cord Circlet
braves-cord-circlet.description: Warrior's headband of woven leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. The small flags, white cloths and sheaves of wheat often found hung from these headbands are prayers of farewell from the people of their home. In bidding farewell t warriors departing on a journey from which they aren't like to return, this small act offers only meager relief.

cerulean-tear-scarab.name: Cerulean Tear Scarab
cerulean-tear-scarab.description: Blue scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of cerulean tears during their labors.

cleanrot-helm.name: Cleanrot Helm
cleanrot-helm.description: Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

carian-knight-helm.name: Carian Knight Helm
carian-knight-helm.description: Helm of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

briar-helm.name: Briar Helm
briar-helm.description: Battered iron helm from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of he Brair.

braves-leather-helm.name: Brave's Leather Helm
braves-leather-helm.description: Battlewear wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands.

cleanrot-helm-altered.name: Cleanrot Helm (altered)
cleanrot-helm-altered.description: Lighter version of the Cleanrot Helm

confessor-hood.name: Confessor Hood
confessor-hood.description: Black hood for blending in with the darkness. Worn by church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

commoners-headband-altered.name: Commoner's Headband (altered)
commoners-headband-altered.description: Lighter version of the Commoner's Headband

confessor-hood-altered.name: Confessor Hood (altered)
confessor-hood-altered.description: Lighter version of the Confessor Hood

commoners-headband.name: Commoner's Headband
commoners-headband.description: A headband with the cloth removed. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

consorts-mask.name: Consort's Mask
consorts-mask.description: Mask worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor, in the image of a foreign queen.

crucible-axe-helm.name: Crucible Axe Helm
crucible-axe-helm.description: Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The axe ornamentation is the knight Ordovis's mark, displayed also by his men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

crimson-hood.name: Crimson Hood
crimson-hood.description: A hooded cloak of vivid crimson.  Worn by expatriates royalty.  Increases vigor.

crimson-tear-scarab.name: Crimson Tear Scarab
crimson-tear-scarab.description: Red scarab worn directly on the head. The red scarabs roll clumps of crimson tears during their labors.

crucible-tree-helm.name: Crucible Tree Helm
crucible-tree-helm.description: Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The great tree ornamentation is the knight Siluria's mark, displayed also by her men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

dialloss-mask.name: Diallos's Mask
dialloss-mask.description: Replica of a twin-tailed silver helm with flowery adornments. Only, without the twin tails.

drake-knight-helm-altered.name: Drake Knight Helm (altered)
drake-knight-helm-altered.description: Lighter version of the Drake Knight Helm.

cuckoo-knight-helm.name: Cuckoo Knight Helm
cuckoo-knight-helm.description: Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Its brow is adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

duelist-helm.name: Duelist Helm
duelist-helm.description: Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

eccentrics-hood.name: Eccentric's Hood
eccentrics-hood.description: A pointy, ragged hood. Worn by the knight Jerren. The hood hides an aged, bearded mask. Jerren served General Radahn as a guest commander, and they are said to have sworn an oath of honorable death to one another.

drake-knight-helm.name: Drake Knight Helm
drake-knight-helm.description: Black iron helm worn by drake knights. Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion. From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe

eccentrics-hood-altered.name: Eccentric's Hood (altered)
eccentrics-hood-altered.description: Lighter version of the Eccentric's Hood

elden-lord-crown.name: Elden Lord Crown
elden-lord-crown.description: Crown of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

envoy-crown.name: Envoy Crown
envoy-crown.description: The soft bundle worn on the head by Oracle Envoys. Densely wrapped in several layers of cloth. Raises the potency of bubble-based skills. No one knows what the cloth hides, but some claim to have heard a faint whimpering from inside. It must have been their imagination.

exile-hood.name: Exile Hood
exile-hood.description: Deep red hood that covers the whole head. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies, who were required to keep their faces hidden.

festive-hood-altered.name: Festive Hood (altered)
festive-hood-altered.description: Lighter version of the Festive Hood

festive-hood.name: Festive Hood
festive-hood.description: Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills. Decorated with many-colored flowers.

finger-maiden-fillet.name: Finger Maiden Fillet
finger-maiden-fillet.description: Fillet worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers. The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers. The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

fire-monk-hood.name: Fire Monk Hood
fire-monk-hood.description: Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with flames. Attire of the Fire Monks.

fire-prelate-helm.name: Fire Prelate Helm
fire-prelate-helm.description: Helm engraved with a sacred countenance and housing a cauldron. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

fias-hood.name: Fia's Hood
fias-hood.description: Hood of black cloth that covers the whole head. Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

fingerprint-helm.name: Fingerprint Helm
fingerprint-helm.description: Iron helm singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

foot-soldier-cap.name: Foot Soldier Cap
foot-soldier-cap.description: Flanged iron cap widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

foot-soldier-helm.name: Foot Soldier Helm
foot-soldier-helm.description: Wholly unembellished iron helm. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

gilded-foot-soldier-cap.name: Gilded Foot Soldier Cap
gilded-foot-soldier-cap.description: Flanged cap made from gilded iron. Issued to foot soldiers protecting the royal capital of Leyndell.

gelmir-knight-helm.name: Gelmir Knight Helm
gelmir-knight-helm.description: Helm worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Its crest of red feathers symbolizes Rykard's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son.

glintstone-scarab.name: Glintstone Scarab
glintstone-scarab.description: Blue-green scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of sorcery during their labors.

godrick-knight-helm.name: Godrick Knight Helm
godrick-knight-helm.description: Gauntlets worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted.

grass-hair-ornament.name: Grass Hair Ornament
grass-hair-ornament.description: A headdress made from wildflowers. Wearing this might make you less easy to spot.

godskin-noble-hood.name: Godskin Noble Hood
godskin-noble-hood.description: Hood made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unilke the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

foot-soldier-helmet.name: Foot Soldier Helmet
foot-soldier-helmet.description: Helmet with a protective metal plate. Widely issued to foot soldiers in lord's army.

godrick-soldier-helm.name: Godrick Soldier Helm
godrick-soldier-helm.description: Helm worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Made from durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif beneath.

godskin-apostle-hood.name: Godskin Apostle Hood
godskin-apostle-hood.description: Hood made by seweing together patches of smooth skin. Worn by the Godskin Apostles.

great-horned-headband.name: Great Horned Headband
great-horned-headband.description: Headband decorated by a pair of great horns.

greathood.name: Greathood
greathood.description: Hood far larger than the head it is meant to cover. A burial shroud of sorts for those who discover, at long last, the truth they sought.

guilty-hood.name: Guilty Hood
guilty-hood.description: Coarse hooded cloak of olive brown. The garb of those accused of lesser crimes, indicated by the collar of sharpened branches.

haima-glintstone-crown.name: Haima Glintstone Crown
haima-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

greathelm.name: Greathelm
greathelm.description: Sturdy greathelm made from iron. Though it is uncomfortably heavy and obstructs the vision of the wearer, it provides considerable damage negation.

haligtree-helm.name: Haligtree Helm
haligtree-helm.description: Helm worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. An iron helm graced by a crown of unalloyed gold. Increases faith.

hierodas-glintstone-crown.name: Hierodas Glintstone Crown
hierodas-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Increases intelligence and endurance to the detriment of FP. The crown of Hierodas was granted to scholars who engaged in nomadic study away from the academy.

haligtree-knight-helm.name: Haligtree Knight Helm
haligtree-knight-helm.description: Helm worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Graced by a crown of unalloyed gold.

high-page-hood.name: High Page Hood
high-page-hood.description: Hood of a page selected for special privilege by the noble they serve.

highwayman-hood.name: Highwayman Hood
highwayman-hood.description: Hideously stained and ragged hood. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

imp-head-cat.name: Imp Head (cat)
imp-head-cat.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling a cat, it holds trace amounts of feline intelligence.

hoslows-helm.name: Hoslow's Helm
hoslows-helm.description: A twin-tailed silver helm decorated with flowery adornments. Symbol of the head of the head of the revered House of Hoslow.

ijis-mirrorhelm.name: Iji's Mirrorhelm
