ijis-mirrorhelm.description: Helm fashioned from a crystal looking-glass, said to have never left War Counselor Iji's head. Easily broken and weak against striking attacks.

imp-head-fanged.name: Imp Head (fanged)
imp-head-fanged.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling a fanged demon, it holds trace amounts of bestial strength.

imp-head-corpse.name: Imp Head (corpse)
imp-head-corpse.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling the visage of a corpse, it holds trace amounts of lingering faith.

imp-head-elder.name: Imp Head (elder)
imp-head-elder.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling an elder, it holds trace amounts of arcane knowledge.

imp-head-long-tongued.name: Imp Head (long-tongued)
imp-head-long-tongued.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.

imp-head-wolf.name: Imp Head (wolf)
imp-head-wolf.description: Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem. Resembling a wolf, it holds trace amounts of lupine endurance.

incantation-scarab.name: Incantation Scarab
incantation-scarab.description: Golden scarab worn directly on the head. These scarabs roll clumps of incantations during their labors. Slightly reduces the FP costs of incantations, but increases damage taken. As a scarab approaches death, it abandons its rolled treasure and stretches its wings wide for long journey to its home nest.

iron-kasa.name: Iron Kasa
iron-kasa.description: Iron kasa of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Crafted to imitate the woven straw hats worn in the Land of Reeds.

iron-helmet.name: Iron Helmet
iron-helmet.description: An iron helmet showing rust on its edges. Cloth covering the mouth and neck provides some resistance to poison and other irritants.

jar.name: Jar
jar.description: Jar that fits cleanly over the head when upturned. Made with pride by Iron Fist Alexander. In a uniquely jarlike gesture of friendship, it boosts the power of throwing pot items.

juvenile-scholar-cap.name: Juvenile Scholar Cap
juvenile-scholar-cap.description: Cap worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria Academy. Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it. Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

knight-helm.name: Knight Helm
knight-helm.description: Iron helm of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

land-of-reeds-helm.name: Land Of Reeds Helm
land-of-reeds-helm.description: Helm made from strips of iron fastened together. Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds. The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil war, during which time it has remained alienated from the cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.

kaiden-helm.name: Kaiden Helm
kaiden-helm.description: Helm worn by Kaiden sellswords. These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the mountaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

lazuli-glintstone-crown.name: Lazuli Glintstone Crown
lazuli-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

malikeths-helm.name: Maliketh's Helm
malikeths-helm.description: Beast's helm made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade.

lusats-glintstone-crown.name: Lusat's Glintstone Crown
lusats-glintstone-crown.description: The giant blue glintstone crown worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

leyndell-knight-helm.name: Leyndell Knight Helm
leyndell-knight-helm.description: Helm worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.

lionels-helm.name: Lionel's Helm
lionels-helm.description: Round iron helm with a distinctive large brim. Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

malenias-winged-helm.name: Malenia's Winged Helm
malenias-winged-helm.description: Winged helm made of unalloyed gold.

malformed-dragon-helm.name: Malformed Dragon Helm
malformed-dragon-helm.description: A malformed golden helm. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

marais-mask.name: Marais Mask
marais-mask.description: Mask in the image of a white-haired young noble. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais. Increases arcane. The Marais family has a dual history spanning generations, serving as both executioners and castellans of the Shaded Castle. This mask bears the likeness of the first of their line.

marionette-soldier-helm.name: Marionette Soldier Helm
marionette-soldier-helm.description: Cylindrical helm of plate metal reinforced with a lattice. Worm by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

leyndell-soldier-helm.name: Leyndell Soldier Helm
leyndell-soldier-helm.description: Helm worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Made from durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif beneath.

marionette-soldier-helm-2.name: Marionette Soldier Helm
marionette-soldier-helm-2.description: Cylindrical helm of plate metal reinforced with a lattice. Worn by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

marionette-soldier-birdhelm.name: Marionette Soldier Birdhelm
marionette-soldier-birdhelm.description: Metal helm formed in the likeness of the face of a bird.

night-maiden-twin-crown.name: Night Maiden Twin Crown
night-maiden-twin-crown.description: Twin crowns worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and hides the eyes with silk. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

mushroom-head.name: Mushroom Head
mushroom-head.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the head.

nights-cavalry-helm.name: Night's Cavalry Helm
nights-cavalry-helm.description: Pitch-black helm with flowing black hair. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

mask-of-confidence.name: Mask Of Confidence
mask-of-confidence.description: Mask with the mouth sewn shut with gold thread. Increases arcane. When Radagon married Rennala, he ordered the Carian magic preceptors to don these masks. To make it clear that all of their matters were to be kept strictly private.

navy-hood.name: Navy Hood
navy-hood.description: A hooded cloak of deep navy. Worn by expatriated royalty. Increases mind. Such cloaks were gifted to those who departed on missions to faraway lands, from which they would never return. But what choice did they have, having seen the guidance of grace?

nights-cavalry-helm-altered.name: Night's Cavalry Helm (altered)
nights-cavalry-helm-altered.description: Lighter version of the Night's Cavalry Helm.

mushroom-crown.name: Mushroom Crown
mushroom-crown.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushrooms form a towering headpiece. Raises attack power when something nearby suffers from poison or rot. Long ago, great lords served the scarlet rot. Perhaps such fungal bodies served as their crowns.

nox-mirrorhelm.name: Nox Mirrorhelm
nox-mirrorhelm.description: Helm fashioned from a crystal looking-glass. One among the Eternal City's ritual implements. Easily broken and weak against striking attacks. Worn by those committed to high treason, it wards off the intervention of the Greater Will and its vassal Fingers.

nox-monk-hood.name: Nox Monk Hood
nox-monk-hood.description: Silk hood worn by the monks of the Eternal City. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

old-aristocrat-cowl.name: Old Aristocrat Cowl
old-aristocrat-cowl.description: Cowl made of soft cloth. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

nox-swordstress-crown.name: Nox Swordstress Crown
nox-swordstress-crown.description: Crown worn by the swordstresses of the Eternal City. These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens, and the silk hides their eyes. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

okina-mask.name: Okina Mask
okina-mask.description: A wooden mask that depicts an old man bearing his teeth. The source of the sobriquet of the great swordman of the Land of Reeds. Raises dexterity as it lowers focus.

nox-swordstress-crown-altered.name: Nox Swordstress Crown (altered)
nox-swordstress-crown-altered.description: Lighter version of the Nox Swordstress Crown.

nox-monk-hood-altered.name: Nox Monk Hood (altered)
nox-monk-hood-altered.description: Lighter version of the Nox Monk Hood.

octopus-head.name: Octopus Head
octopus-head.description: A land octopus whelp worn directly on the head. Has a lingering warmth reminiscent of human skin. Those who can withstand the smell will find its organic elasticity excellent for negating strikes.

omen-helm.name: Omen Helm
omen-helm.description: Malformed helm resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

olivinus-glintstone-crown.name: Olivinus Glintstone Crown
olivinus-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Increases intelligence to the detriment of HP. The lineage of the Olivinus Conspectus began with the sorcerer Lusat, and its adherents continue his study of meteors.

perfumer-hood.name: Perfumer Hood
perfumer-hood.description: Hood of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

omensmirk-mask.name: Omensmirk Mask
omensmirk-mask.description: Mask with long, hideously twisted horns worn by the Omenkillers. Increases strength. Bears the smirking face of an elder, twisted in wicked delight. This visage is carved in the image of the evil spirits that haunt the Omen in their nightmares.

preceptors-big-hat.name: Preceptor's Big Hat
preceptors-big-hat.description: Large hat with the movements of the stars drawn on the inside of the brim. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals.

prisoner-iron-mask.name: Prisoner Iron Mask
prisoner-iron-mask.description: Iron mask forced on a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Thick, heavy, and utterly stifling. A foul creation designed to torment the wearer, either slowly fermenting hatred within their heart, or a spiritual fervor that is near indistinguishable from it.

queens-crescent-crown.name: Queen's Crescent Crown
queens-crescent-crown.description: A tall crown depicting the moon. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. Increases intelligence. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

radahn-soldier-helm.name: Radahn Soldier Helm
radahn-soldier-helm.description: Helm worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Its visor is fashioned after a lion's fangs.

page-hood.name: Page Hood
page-hood.description: Hood worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way. The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen and unknown stature.

prophet-blindfold.name: Prophet Blindfold
prophet-blindfold.description: Blindfold of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Why hesitate, if the path leading to the future is clear? Just close your eyes, and walk.

pumpkin-helm.name: Pumpkin Helm
pumpkin-helm.description: An oval helmet large enough to cover any head. Very heavy and very hard. Reduces damage from headshots and impacts. The inside of the helm is pitch black, keeping the crazed warrior within from panicking. Perhaps its rather roomy interior also helps alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

radahns-redmane-helm.name: Radahn's Redmane Helm
radahns-redmane-helm.description: Helm of the golden lion, with flowing red hair. Worn by General Radahn.

ragged-hat-altered.name: Ragged Hat (altered)
ragged-hat-altered.description: Lighter version of the Ragged Hat.

radiant-gold-mask.name: Radiant Gold Mask
radiant-gold-mask.description: A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo. Created and left behind by Lord Goldmask, a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism. Strenthens Golden Order incantations. Its striking design represents both the brilliant inspiration that once shone upon him, and the vision of a ring that he will surely find at the end of his pursuit. "To you who seek to shine as I do, wear it well!"

ragged-hat.name: Ragged Hat
ragged-hat.description: Helm pieced together from scavenged metal.

raya-lucarian-helm.name: Raya Lucarian Helm
raya-lucarian-helm.description: Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Its brow adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

rotten-duelist-helm.name: Rotten Duelist Helm
rotten-duelist-helm.description: Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

royal-remains-helm.name: Royal Remains Helm
royal-remains-helm.description: Helm graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

royal-knight-helm.name: Royal Knight Helm
royal-knight-helm.description: Silver helm of Loretta, a Knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

redmane-knight-helm-2.name: Redmane Knight Helm
redmane-knight-helm-2.description: Helm worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

sacred-crown-helm.name: Sacred Crown Helm
sacred-crown-helm.description: Flanged iron cap adorned with a crown of unalloyed gold. Increases faith. Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Who is it that Miquella shall bless, if not the low and the meek?

rulers-mask.name: Ruler's Mask
rulers-mask.description: Mask in the image of a wizened sage. Customary dress among lords in a smaller nation. Increases faith. Such a mask illustrates the qualities of an ideal lord: chiefly, wise and possessing a certain defanged geniality. One at the center of society often finds these qualities most expedient.

scaled-helm.name: Scaled Helm
scaled-helm.description: Helm worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

shining-horned-headband.name: Shining Horned Headband
shining-horned-headband.description: Headband decorated by a pair of shining horns. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

sanguine-noble-hood.name: Sanguine Noble Hood
sanguine-noble-hood.description: Hood of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood. Known to strike from pools of blood, these assassins are missionaries come to share the gospel of accursed blood.

sage-hood.name: Sage Hood
sage-hood.description: A burgundy pointed hood. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

skeletal-mask.name: Skeletal Mask
skeletal-mask.description: Skeletal mask that tightly grips the face. Worn by the assassin's of Ravensmount.

snow-witch-hat.name: Snow Witch Hat
snow-witch-hat.description: Witch's pointed hat, frigid and frozen through. Of a style associated with practitioners of heretical sorcery. Strengthens cold sorcery. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

spellblades-pointed-hat.name: Spellblade's Pointed Hat
spellblades-pointed-hat.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

silver-tear-mask.name: Silver Tear Mask
silver-tear-mask.description: Mask fashioned from the corpse of a formless Silver Tear, supported by its hardened, shed husk. Greatly increases arcane to the detriment of physical attack power. To imitate the imitator is a cunning play indeed.

travelers-hat.name: Traveler's Hat
travelers-hat.description: Hat of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

vulgar-militia-helm.name: Vulgar Militia Helm
vulgar-militia-helm.description: Helm worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen. The upward extension serves to create an appearance of larger size, however slightly.

witchs-glintstone-crown.name: Witch's Glintstone Crown
witchs-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

twinsage-glintstone-crown.name: Twinsage Glintstone Crown
twinsage-glintstone-crown.description: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Greatly increases intelligence to the detriment of HP and stamina. Scholars of the Twinsage Conspectus were the elites of the academy, permitted to study and excel in sorceries of all kinds.

veterans-helm.name: Veteran's Helm
veterans-helm.description: An old helm that has seen many battles.Worn by Niall, the great veteran general of Sol.

white-mask.name: White Mask
white-mask.description: Bloodstained, faintly grinning mask. Worn by war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. The Lord of Blood's curse enlivens the wearer when bloodletting occurs. Slightly raises attack power when there is blood loss nearby.

tree-sentinel-helm.name: Tree Sentinel Helm
tree-sentinel-helm.description: Golden helm of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

twinned-helm.name: Twinned Helm
twinned-helm.description: Helm depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

vagabond-knight-helm.name: Vagabond Knight Helm
vagabond-knight-helm.description: Helm of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

zamor-mask.name: Zamor Mask
zamor-mask.description: Mask worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants. These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.

astrologer-trousers.name: Astrologer Trousers
astrologer-trousers.description: Trousers worn inside a robe. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

battlemage-legwraps.name: Battlemage Legwraps
battlemage-legwraps.description: Legwraps worn by the scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.

aristocrat-boots.name: Aristocrat Boots
aristocrat-boots.description: Boots made from tanned leather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Abandoning their birthplace after the shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

banished-knight-greaves.name: Banished Knight Greaves
banished-knight-greaves.description: Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. These greaves were worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

blackflame-monk-greave.name: Blackflame Monk Greave
blackflame-monk-greave.description: Black iron greaves featuring a flame motif.

beast-champion-greaves.name: Beast Champion Greaves
beast-champion-greaves.description: Silver greaves engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

black-knife-greaves.name: Black Knife Greaves
black-knife-greaves.description: Greaves used by the Black Knife Assassins. Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound. The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

blaidds-greaves.name: Blaidd's Greaves
blaidds-greaves.description: Well-worn black greaves of the man-wolf Blaidd.

cleanrot-greaves.name: Cleanrot Greaves
cleanrot-greaves.description: Greaves of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

blue-silver-mail-skirt.name: Blue Silver Mail Skirt
blue-silver-mail-skirt.description: Chainmail skirt crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

briar-greaves.name: Briar Greaves
briar-greaves.description: Battered iron greaves from a foreign land. Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

braves-legwraps.name: Brave's Legwraps
braves-legwraps.description: Greaves wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. Has a fur lining which excels at keeping the cold at bay.

commoners-shoes.name: Commoner's Shoes
commoners-shoes.description: Modest shoes made of cloth. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

carian-knight-greaves.name: Carian Knight Greaves
carian-knight-greaves.description: Greaves of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all decorated heroes, were heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

cloth-trousers.name: Cloth Trousers
cloth-trousers.description: Trousers made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

chain-leggings.name: Chain Leggings
chain-leggings.description: Leggings made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

bloodhound-knight-greaves.name: Bloodhound Knight Greaves
bloodhound-knight-greaves.description: Metal greaves of the Bloodhound Knights. The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers. Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master. Once the decision has been made the knight stays loyal for life.

bull-goat-greaves.name: Bull-goat Greaves
bull-goat-greaves.description: Great Horned Tragoth's greaves. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

cuckoo-knight-greaves.name: Cuckoo Knight Greaves
cuckoo-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

crucible-greaves.name: Crucible Greaves
crucible-greaves.description: Greaves of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Hold the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthen Aspects of the Crucible incantations. In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

confessor-boots.name: Confessor Boots
confessor-boots.description: Leather boots of the church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

drake-knight-greaves.name: Drake Knight Greaves
drake-knight-greaves.description: Greaves wrapped in thick leather. Garb worn by warriors of the frigid uplands. Has a fur lining which excels at keeping the cold at bay.

consorts-trousers.name: Consort's Trousers
consorts-trousers.description: Fine white trousers, perfectly suited for wearing beneath a silk robe.

deathbed-smalls.name: Deathbed Smalls
deathbed-smalls.description: Skirt worn by Phia, the Deathbed Companion.

eccentrics-breeches.name: Eccentric's Breeches
eccentrics-breeches.description: The knight Jerren's breeches. Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became the guest commander for General Radahn. And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

duelist-greaves.name: Duelist Greaves
duelist-greaves.description: Greaves encircles by bronze snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

elden-lord-greaves.name: Elden Lord Greaves
elden-lord-greaves.description: Greaves of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield. He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

errant-sorcerer-boots.name: Errant Sorcerer Boots
errant-sorcerer-boots.description: Commonplace leather boots, sturdy enough to withstand a long journey.

fire-prelate-greaves.name: Fire Prelate Greaves
fire-prelate-greaves.description: Black iron greaves with the appearance of flames. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

fur-leggings.name: Fur Leggings
fur-leggings.description: Leggings fashioned from bristly pelts. Worn by ancestral follower warriors. The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

fingerprint-greaves.name: Fingerprint Greaves
fingerprint-greaves.description: Iron greaves singed and blistered by fingers. Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

finger-maiden-shoes.name: Finger Maiden Shoes
finger-maiden-shoes.description: Shoes worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers. The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers. The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

exile-greaves.name: Exile Greaves
exile-greaves.description: Damaged iron greaves. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

foot-soldier-greaves.name: Foot Soldier Greaves
foot-soldier-greaves.description: Metal Graves that have already been mended countless times. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

gelmir-knight-greaves.name: Gelmir Knight Greaves
gelmir-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard. Time has yet to dull their luster.

godrick-knight-greaves.name: Godrick Knight Greaves
godrick-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time has yet to dull their luster.

fire-monk-greaves.name: Fire Monk Greaves
fire-monk-greaves.description: Black iron greaves featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Fire Monks.

godrick-soldier-greaves.name: Godrick Soldier Greaves
godrick-soldier-greaves.description: Greaves worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

gold-waistwrap.name: Gold Waistwrap
gold-waistwrap.description: Waistwrap made in the image of Erdtree branches. A minimal adornment made by Lord Goldmask's disciples. Those disciples have long since left him.

haligtree-knight-greaves.name: Haligtree Knight Greaves
haligtree-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.

godskin-apostle-trousers.name: Godskin Apostle Trousers
godskin-apostle-trousers.description: Trousers made by seweing together patches of smooth skin.

hoslows-greaves.name: Hoslow's Greaves
hoslows-greaves.description: Garish silver greaves decorated with red embellishments. Passed down through the Hoslow family.

haligtree-greaves.name: Haligtree Greaves
haligtree-greaves.description: Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

godskin-noble-trousers.name: Godskin Noble Trousers
godskin-noble-trousers.description: Trousers made by sewing together patches of smooth skin. Subcutaneous fat makes them plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles. Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

guardian-greaves.name: Guardian Greaves
guardian-greaves.description: Engraved golden greaves. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

knight-greaves.name: Knight Greaves
knight-greaves.description: Iron greaves of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

leather-boots.name: Leather Boots
leather-boots.description: Lightweight and battle-proven leather boots worn by a savvy soldier. Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

leather-trousers.name: Leather Trousers
leather-trousers.description: Well-made leather trousers. The lower legs are each bound in cord for ease of movement.

leyndell-knight-greaves.name: Leyndell Knight Greaves
leyndell-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster.

leyndell-soldier-greaves.name: Leyndell Soldier Greaves
leyndell-soldier-greaves.description: Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

lionels-greaves.name: Lionel's Greaves
lionels-greaves.description: Rounded iron greaves. Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

malenias-greaves.name: Malenia's Greaves
malenias-greaves.description: Greaves made of unalloyed gold. Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk. "My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

malikeths-greaves.name: Maliketh's Greaves
malikeths-greaves.description: Beast's greaves made of black iron and decorated with gold. Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade. Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him. Champions knew what was at stake. Indeed, that is what made them champions.

mausoleum-greaves.name: Mausoleum Greaves
mausoleum-greaves.description: Greaves worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Museum. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

mausoleum-knight-greaves.name: Mausoleum Knight Greaves
mausoleum-knight-greaves.description: Greaves worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Time has yet to dull their luster.

old-sorcerer-legwraps.name: Old Sorcerer Legwraps
old-sorcerer-legwraps.description: Ragged waistcloth that extends to the thighs. Common amongst old-fashioned sorcerers.

nox-monk-greaves.name: Nox Monk Greaves
nox-monk-greaves.description: Greaves worn by the monks of the Eternal City. Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

omenkiller-boots.name: Omenkiller Boots
omenkiller-boots.description: Long, stiff leather gloves worn by the Omenkillers.

nomadic-merchants-trousers.name: Nomadic Merchant's Trousers
nomadic-merchants-trousers.description: Trousers of the nomadic merchants. These merchants once thrived as the Great Caravan, but after being accused of heretical beliefs, their entire clan was rounded up and buried alive far underground. Then, they chanted a curse of despair, and summoned the flame of frenzy.

page-trousers.name: Page Trousers
page-trousers.description: Trousers worn by pages who serve nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

nights-cavalry-greaves.name: Night's Cavalry Greaves
nights-cavalry-greaves.description: Pitch-black greaves thinly painted with dried blood. Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

mushroom-legs.name: Mushroom Legs
mushroom-legs.description: Mushrooms found growing all over the body. These overgrown mushroom have colonized the Legs.  To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

omen-greaves.name: Omen Greaves
omen-greaves.description: Malformed greaves resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

old-aristocrat-shoes.name: Old Aristocrat Shoes
old-aristocrat-shoes.description: Hard-wearing shoes made of leather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.

nobles-trousers.name: Noble's Trousers
nobles-trousers.description: White trousers of superior craftsmanship. Worn by expatriated royalty. A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

ragged-loincloth.name: Ragged Loincloth
ragged-loincloth.description: Greaves pieced together from scavenged metal.

perfumer-sarong.name: Perfumer Sarong
perfumer-sarong.description: Sarong of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

preceptors-trousers.name: Preceptor's Trousers
preceptors-trousers.description: Trousers of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.

prophet-trousers.name: Prophet Trousers
prophet-trousers.description: Trousers of the exiled prophets who foresaw that their faith would end in flames — and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. Its fabric scrapes against their skin like a file, and the rickety cart wheel around the neck warns passers-by not to lend an ear to their meandering sermons.

queens-leggings.name: Queen's Leggings
queens-leggings.description: Leggings indicating the highest order of sorcerer. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

raya-lucarian-greaves.name: Raya Lucarian Greaves
raya-lucarian-greaves.description: Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

prisoner-trousers.name: Prisoner Trousers
prisoner-trousers.description: Tattered trousers. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Never once washed, every fiber is filthy. The smell is beyond belief.

redmane-knight-greaves.name: Redmane Knight Greaves
redmane-knight-greaves.description: Black iron greaves worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.

radahns-greaves.name: Radahn's Greaves
radahns-greaves.description: Greaves depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.

radahn-soldier-greaves.name: Radahn Soldier Greaves
radahn-soldier-greaves.description: Greaves worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

royal-knight-greaves.name: Royal Knight Greaves
royal-knight-greaves.description: Silver greaves of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

ronins-greaves.name: Ronin's Greaves
ronins-greaves.description: Greaves of the man who calls himself Shabriri. Highly functional and heavily worn.

royal-remains-greaves.name: Royal Remains Greaves
royal-remains-greaves.description: Greaves graced with gold human bones. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

sage-trousers.name: Sage Trousers
sage-trousers.description: Thick burgundy trousers. Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical. Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

shaman-leggings.name: Shaman Leggings
shaman-leggings.description: Leggings fashioned from bristly pelts. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

snow-witch-skirt.name: Snow Witch Skirt
snow-witch-skirt.description: Witch's skirt in the color of snow. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

scaled-greaves.name: Scaled Greaves
scaled-greaves.description: Gauntlets worn by Old Knight Istvan. The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it high effective against non-physical attacks. Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survived to this day.

rotten-duelist-greaves.name: Rotten Duelist Greaves
rotten-duelist-greaves.description: Greaves wrapped with bronze snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

spellblades-trousers.name: Spellblade's Trousers
spellblades-trousers.description: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

sorcerer-leggings.name: Sorcerer Leggings
sorcerer-leggings.description: Leggings worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the legs.

travelers-slops.name: Traveler's Slops
travelers-slops.description: Slops of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

veterans-greaves.name: Veteran's Greaves
veterans-greaves.description: An old greaves that has seen many battles.Worn by Niall, the great veteran general of Sol.

twinned-greaves.name: Twinned Greaves
twinned-greaves.description: Greaves depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

tree-sentinel-greaves.name: Tree Sentinel Greaves
tree-sentinel-greaves.description: Golden greaves of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

war-surgeon-trousers.name: War Surgeon Trousers
war-surgeon-trousers.description: Bloodstained trousers of the war surgeons who were effectively mercy killers. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception

vulgar-militia-greaves.name: Vulgar Militia Greaves
vulgar-militia-greaves.description: Greaves worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

warrior-greaves.name: Warrior Greaves
warrior-greaves.description: Greaves of a nomadic warrior. Crafted from sturdy leather.

vagabond-knight-greaves.name: Vagabond Knight Greaves
vagabond-knight-greaves.description: Greaves of a knight banished from their motherland. Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

white-reed-greaves.name: White Reed Greaves
white-reed-greaves.description: Greaves of the White Reeds, fashioned from banded iron plates. Worn by the Inabam head disciples of the great swordsman Okina. The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothingmore than to die by the sword.

zamor-legwraps.name: Zamor Legwraps
zamor-legwraps.description: Legwraps worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants. These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.

champion-gaiters.name: Champion Gaiters
champion-gaiters.description: Gaiters worn by a champion of the badlands. Part of the Hero starting set.
